import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
d=Path(sys.argv[1]); src=Path('gobreaker.go').read_text().splitlines()
def cites(ns): return ' '.join(f'gobreaker.go:{n} ("{src[n-1].strip()}").' for n in ns)
out=['# Open domain questions']
for n,(f,tr,question,answer,lines,options) in enumerate(json.loads(sys.argv[2]),1):
 out += [f'\n## Q-{n:02} — {question}',f'**Fault:** {f}',f'**Trigger:** {tr}',f'**Question:** {question}',f'**Current behaviour:** observed-in-code. {answer} {cites(lines)}',f'**Options:** {options}', '**Proposed:** defer selection to the owner.', '**Status:** OPEN — human decision required.']
(d/'open-questions.md').write_text('\n\n'.join(out)+'\n')
